summary.text: Rob Johnson is a Democratic state representative who has represented Iowa House District 34 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia describes Johnson as a faith leader, community activist and mental health advocate.

paragraphs.text: Rev. Rob Johnson's career experience includes being a faith leader, community activist and mental health advocate, according to Ballotpedia.
Johnson has been a board member for Iowa Juneteenth, Taste of the Junction, Back 2 School Iowa, the Interfaith Alliance of Iowa, and I'll Make Me A World In Iowa.
In the 2025-2026 session Johnson was assigned to the House Appropriations, Commerce and Human Resources committees.
